nodes.summary: Implement standalone TF module main.tf with stackit_secretsmanager_instance and stackit_secretsmanager_user
Implement variables.tf with six required variables
Implement outputs.tf with instance_id, username, password (sensitive)
Add SECRETS_MANAGER_NAMESPACE and SECRETS_MANAGER_AUTH_METHOD_DETAILS to module.contract.yaml
Implement secrets_manager_namespace() returning SECRETS_MANAGER_INSTANCE_NAME
Implement secrets_manager_auth_method_details() returning username (non-sensitive)
Implement secrets_manager_reconcile_runtime_secret() and secrets_manager_delete_runtime_secret() — reconcile writes K8s Secret, delete removes it
Update secrets_manager_apply.sh to write namespace + auth_method_details and call reconcile_runtime_secret
Update secrets_manager_plan.sh to write namespace to plan state
Update secrets_manager_smoke.sh to validate namespace and auth_method_details keys are non-empty
Implement test_contract.py with >= 10 assertions
Update secrets_manager_destroy.sh to call secrets_manager_delete_runtime_secret()
Add test_contract.py to test_pyramid_contract.json before creating the test file
Password MUST NOT appear in state file, CI logs, or non-sensitive artifacts
namespace and auth_method_details in runtime state; smoke validates both keys non-empty; prefixed output
lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true } on instance resource
namespace and auth_method_details in runtime state for operator use
N/A — no UI or frontend changes
main.tf declares stackit_secretsmanager_instance.this with required attrs and lifecycle block
main.tf declares stackit_secretsmanager_user.this with required attributes
variables.tf declares all six required variables
outputs.tf declares instance_id, username, password (sensitive)
versions.tf exists and declares stackitcloud/stackit required provider with pinned version constraint
module.contract.yaml includes SECRETS_MANAGER_NAMESPACE and SECRETS_MANAGER_AUTH_METHOD_DETAILS
secrets_manager_namespace() returns SECRETS_MANAGER_INSTANCE_NAME
secrets_manager_auth_method_details() returns username from runtime state
secrets_manager_reconcile_runtime_secret() and secrets_manager_delete_runtime_secret() both exist and operate on blueprint-secrets-manager-auth
secrets_manager_apply.sh writes namespace + auth_method_details and calls reconcile_runtime_secret
secrets_manager_plan.sh writes namespace to plan state
secrets_manager_smoke.sh exits non-zero if namespace or auth_method_details absent or empty
Runtime state file MUST NOT contain the password value
test_contract.py passes with >= 10 assertions
secrets_manager_destroy.sh calls secrets_manager_delete_runtime_secret()
test_contract.py has entry in test_pyramid_contract.json under unit scope
